package.name: mowgli_lidar_pwm
package.description: Owns the LD19 LiDAR spin-motor's PWM control line (issue #569). Spins the motor down while the robot is idle and back up before navigation needs scans, driven by the robot's HighLevelStatus and a sysfs PWM device. Publishes mowgli_interfaces/LidarMotorStatus so mowgli_behavior can gate motion on the motor actually being healthy.
